newsitem.title: GERMANY: Canada 97/98 oilseeds output forecast increased.
newsitem.headline: Canada 97/98 oilseeds output forecast increased.

text.p: Canada's 1997/98 oilseeds output should reach 10.56 million tonnes, compared with an earlier figure of 10.49 million and last season's 8.11 million, the independent newsletter Oil World on Tuesday.
It based the forecast on June 27 area estimates from Statistics Canada, which were above initial Oil World expectations.

Oil World pegged Canada's combined area of soybeans, sunseed, rapeseed (canola) and linseed at 6.74 million hectares compared with its initial forecast of 6.68 million and a 1996/97 area of 4.95 million ha.
It put the average yield of the four crops at 1.57 tonnes per ha, compared with 1.64 last year.
The canola crop alone was forecast at 6.6 million tonnes from 4.82 million ha.
Soybeans output was forecast at 2.72 million tonnes from 1.04 million ha.
Southern and central parts of Saskatchewan and Manitoba were showing soil moisture deficits, Oil World noted.
Alberta, by contrast, was reporting excessive moisture and cool weather, which slowed crop development.
